definitions: When visiting a foreign place, one should observe and follow the customs of the local population.
It is advisable to conform to the local customs and practices when in an unfamiliar environment.
examples: I don't usually eat dinner so late, but in Rome do as the Romans do, so I'll join you.
When I moved to Japan, I quickly learned that in Rome do as the Romans do, especially regarding bowing.
She wasn't used to the siesta, but decided in Rome do as the Romans do and took a nap.
lemma: in Rome do as the Romans do
source: in Rome do as the Romans do
